description: A vanilla Orbital Skyhook anchored at a high-sec or low-sec planet mines that planet's P0 resource (the best-quality one, or the one named by a Planetary Drill (<P0>) item) into its secured bay; Extract to cargo works as for sov null-sec Skyhooks. Requires skyhookOrphanFix (loaded before this mod); the drill items come from customTypes. Off by default (EVEJS_PDRILL_ENABLED). Danger: drill stock is lost if the mod is turned off or stops working after an EveJS update, or if a drill's P0 changes. Extract first. Read the README.
